CREATE TRIGGER AR_InvoiceDetailTbl_UpdateStockTrans
ON dbo.AR_InvoiceDetailTbl
AFTER INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    DELETE st
    FROM dbo.IV_StockTransactionTbl st
		INNER JOIN deleted d  ON st.DocumentID = d.DocumentID AND st.UserAutoID = d.UserAutoID
    WHERE st.TranType ='SI';  -- xóa het, insert lai, tránh insert 2 lần, tranh đổi khóa
   
    INSERT INTO dbo.IV_StockTransactionTbl 
	(TranType, BranchID, DocumentID, DocumentDate, UserAutoID, ItemID, StoreHouseID, InvAccID, Lot, ExpireDate, Property, Property2, Quantity, Amount)
    SELECT 'SI',m.BranchID, i.DocumentID, m.DocumentDate, i.UserAutoID, i.ItemID, i.StoreHouseID, i.InvAccID, i.Lot, i.ExpireDate, i.Property, i.Property2,
        -i.Quantity, -i.AmountCost
    FROM inserted i
    INNER JOIN dbo.AR_InvoiceTbl m ON i.DocumentID = m.DocumentID
    WHERE ISNULL(i.InvAccID,'') <> '' AND COALESCE(i.CostOfSaleAccID,'')  <> ''
 

END

CREATE   TRIGGER dbo.AR_InvoiceDetailTbl_UpdateEntryTrans
ON dbo.AR_InvoiceDetailTbl
AFTER INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DELETE st
    FROM dbo.GJ_TransactionTbl st
		INNER JOIN deleted d  ON st.DocumentID = d.DocumentID AND st.UserAutoID = d.UserAutoID
    WHERE st.SourceID ='SI';  -- xóa het, insert lai, tránh insert 2 lần, tranh đổi khóa
   
    INSERT INTO dbo.GJ_TransactionTbl 
	(SourceID, BranchID, DocumentID, DocumentDate, UserAutoID, InvoiceNo, ObjectID, ObjectID2, CurrencyID, RateExchange , Memo, MasterMemo, CostCenterID, CostID ,RefDoc,
	 DebitAccID,  CreditAccID, SourceAmount, Amount, ItemID, Quantity, ContractID, EmployeeID , ManagerID)

	SELECT 'SI', BranchID, A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, UserAutoID, InvoiceNo, 
	CASE when Coalesce(AgencyID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else AgencyID end ObjectID,
	CASE when Coalesce(AgencyID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else AgencyID end ObjectID2,
	CurrencyID, RateExchange , COALESCE(DienGiai,Memo) Memo, Memo MasterMemo, 
	COALESCE(A.CostCenterID, B.CostCenterID) CostCenterID, COALESCE(A.CostID, B.CostID) CostID ,RefDoc,
	RevAccID AS DebitAccID,  IncomeAccID AS CreditAccID, COALESCE(SourceAmount,0)  - COALESCE(DiscountAmountTT,0) / RateExchange AS SourceAmount, 
		COALESCE(Amount,0) - COALESCE(DiscountAmountTT,0) AS Amount,  ItemID, Quantity, ContractID,  COALESCE(B.EmployeeID,A.EmployeeID ) AS EmployeeID , A.ManagerID
	FROM AR_InvoiceTbl A   
		INNER JOIN  Inserted B   ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID

	UNION ALL

	-- chi duoc lay so luong theo cong no, cac tk khac ko duoc lay sl ra, neu chiet khau vao tk cong no, lay so luong ra se bi double
	SELECT 'SI', BranchID, A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, UserAutoID, InvoiceNo,  
	CASE when Coalesce(AgencyID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else AgencyID end ObjectID , 
	CASE when Coalesce(AgencyID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else AgencyID end ObjectID2,
	CurrencyID, RateExchange , Memo, Memo MasterMemo, 
	COALESCE(A.CostCenterID, B.CostCenterID) , COALESCE(A.CostID, B.CostID) ,RefDoc,
	CASE WHEN COALESCE(VATAccID2,'') <> '' THEN VATAccID2 ELSE RevAccID END AS DebitAccID,  
	VATAccID AS CreditAccID, (VATAmount) / RateExchange AS SourceAmount, (VATAmount) AS Amount, ItemID, NULL, ContractID, COALESCE(B.EmployeeID,A.EmployeeID ), A.ManagerID
	FROM AR_InvoiceTbl A   INNER JOIN  Inserted B   ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
	WHERE COALESCE(VATAmount,0) <> 0



	UNION ALL
	-- Gia Vốn HH
	SELECT 'SI', BranchID, A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, UserAutoID,InvoiceNo, 
	CASE when Coalesce(AgencyID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else AgencyID end ObjectID ,
	CASE when Coalesce(AgencyID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else AgencyID end ObjectID2,
	CurrencyID, RateExchange , Memo, Memo MasterMemo,  B.CostCenterID, B.CostID,RefDoc,
	CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.Amount,0) = 0 THEN COALESCE(I.ExpenseAccID,B.CostOfSaleAccID ) ELSE B.CostOfSaleAccID END AS DebitAccID,  
	B.InvAccID AS CreditAccID, 0 AS SourceAmount, COALESCE(AmountCost,0) AS Amount, B.ItemID,  Quantity, ContractID, NULL, null
	FROM AR_InvoiceTbl A   
			INNER JOIN  Inserted B   ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
			LEFT JOIN  CF_ItemTbl I ON B.ItemID= I.ItemID
	WHERE COALESCE(I.IsService,0) = 0 AND COALESCE(B.CostOfSaleAccID,'') <> '' AND COALESCE(B.InvAccID,'') <> ''
  
 
	-- thue xuat khau
	UNION ALL

	SELECT 'SI',BranchID, A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, UserAutoID,InvoiceNo,  
	CASE when Coalesce(AgencyID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else AgencyID end ObjectID ,
	CASE when Coalesce(AgencyID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else AgencyID end ObjectID2,
	CurrencyID, RateExchange , Memo, Memo MasterMemo, COALESCE(A.CostCenterID, B.CostCenterID) , COALESCE(A.CostID, B.CostID) ,RefDoc,
	IncomeAccID AS DebitAccID, VATAccExID AS CreditAccID, 
	(ExportAmount) / RateExchange AS SourceAmount, (ExportAmount) AS Amount, ItemID, NULL, ContractID, NULL, null
	FROM AR_InvoiceTbl A   INNER JOIN  Inserted B   ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
	WHERE COALESCE(ExportAmount,0) <> 0

	-- chiet khau. phai tham chieu vao chinh chung tu nay
	UNION ALL

	SELECT 'SI', BranchID,  A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, UserAutoID,InvoiceNo, 
	CASE when Coalesce(AgencyID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else AgencyID end ObjectID ,
	CASE when Coalesce(AgencyID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else AgencyID end ObjectID2,
	CurrencyID, RateExchange , Memo, Memo MasterMemo, 
		COALESCE(A.CostCenterID, B.CostCenterID) , COALESCE(A.CostID, B.CostID) ,A.DocumentID RefDoc,
		B.DiscountAcctID AS DebitAccID, RevAccID AS CreditAccID, 0 AS SourceAmount, 
	(COALESCE(DiscountAmount,0) + COALESCE(DiscountAmount2,0) ) AS Amount, ItemID, NULL, ContractID, COALESCE(B.EmployeeID,A.EmployeeID ) AS EmployeeID , A.ManagerID
	FROM AR_InvoiceTbl A   
		INNER JOIN  Inserted B   ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
	WHERE ( COALESCE(DiscountAmount,0) + COALESCE(DiscountAmount2,0)  <> 0 ) AND  COALESCE(DiscountAcctID,'') <> ''




	-- chiet khau BS : TienChietKhau1, ChietKhau1AccID
	UNION ALL

	SELECT 'SI', BranchID, A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, UserAutoID,InvoiceNo,  
	CASE when Coalesce(AgencyID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else AgencyID end ObjectID  , 
	CASE when Coalesce(AgencyID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else AgencyID end ObjectID2,
	CurrencyID, RateExchange , Memo, Memo MasterMemo, 
		COALESCE(A.CostCenterID, B.CostCenterID) , COALESCE(A.CostID, B.CostID) ,A.DocumentID RefDoc,
		DiscountAcctID AS CreditAccID, A.ChietKhau1AccID AS DebitAccID,  0 AS SourceAmount, 
	(COALESCE(TienChietKhau1,0)) AS Amount,  ItemID, NULL, ContractID,  COALESCE(B.EmployeeID,A.EmployeeID ) AS EmployeeID , A.ManagerID
	FROM AR_InvoiceTbl A   
		INNER JOIN  Inserted B   ON  A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
	WHERE ( COALESCE(TienChietKhau1,0)  <> 0 ) AND  COALESCE(ChietKhau1AccID,'') <> ''



	-- chiet khau NT  
	UNION ALL

	SELECT 'SI', BranchID,  A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, UserAutoID,InvoiceNo,  
	CASE when Coalesce(AgencyID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else AgencyID end ObjectID ,	
	CASE when Coalesce(AgencyID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else AgencyID end ObjectID2,
 CurrencyID, RateExchange , Memo, Memo MasterMemo, 
		COALESCE(A.CostCenterID, B.CostCenterID) , COALESCE(A.CostID, B.CostID) ,A.DocumentID RefDoc,
		 DiscountAcctID AS CreditAccID, A.ChietKhau2AccID AS DebitAccID, 0 AS SourceAmount,  
	(COALESCE(TienChietKhau2,0)) AS Amount,  ItemID, NULL, ContractID,  COALESCE(B.EmployeeID,A.EmployeeID ) AS EmployeeID , A.ManagerID
	FROM AR_InvoiceTbl A   
		INNER JOIN  Inserted B   ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
	WHERE ( COALESCE(TienChietKhau2,0)  <> 0 ) AND  COALESCE(ChietKhau2AccID,'') <> ''


	-- chiet khau khoa duoc
	UNION ALL

	SELECT 'SI', BranchID,  A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, UserAutoID,InvoiceNo,  
	CASE when Coalesce(AgencyID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else AgencyID end ObjectID , 	
	CASE when Coalesce(AgencyID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else AgencyID end ObjectID2,
  CurrencyID, RateExchange , Memo, Memo MasterMemo, 
		COALESCE(A.CostCenterID, B.CostCenterID) , COALESCE(A.CostID, B.CostID) ,A.DocumentID RefDoc,
		DiscountAcctID AS CreditAccID, A.ChietKhau3AccID AS DebitAccID,  0 AS SourceAmount, 
	(COALESCE(TienChietKhau3,0)) AS Amount, ItemID, NULL, ContractID, COALESCE(B.EmployeeID,A.EmployeeID ) AS EmployeeID , A.ManagerID
	FROM AR_InvoiceTbl A   
		INNER JOIN  Inserted B   ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
	WHERE ( COALESCE(TienChietKhau3,0)  <> 0 ) AND  COALESCE(ChietKhau3AccID,'') <> ''

	-- chiet khau khac
	UNION ALL

	SELECT 'SI', BranchID, A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, UserAutoID,InvoiceNo,  
	CASE when Coalesce(AgencyID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else AgencyID end ObjectID, 
	CASE when Coalesce(AgencyID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else AgencyID end ObjectID2,
	CurrencyID, RateExchange , Memo, Memo MasterMemo, 
		COALESCE(A.CostCenterID, B.CostCenterID) , COALESCE(A.CostID, B.CostID) ,A.DocumentID RefDoc,
		DiscountAcctID AS CreditAccID, A.ChietKhau4AccID AS DebitAccID, 0 AS SourceAmount, 
	(COALESCE(TienChietKhau4,0)) + (COALESCE(TienChietKhau5,0)) + (COALESCE(TienChietKhau6,0)) + (COALESCE(TienChietKhau7,0)) 
	+ (COALESCE(TienChietKhau8,0))  + (COALESCE(TienChietKhau9,0))   AS Amount, 
	 ItemID, NULL, ContractID,  COALESCE(B.EmployeeID,A.EmployeeID ) AS EmployeeID , A.ManagerID
	FROM AR_InvoiceTbl A   
		INNER JOIN  Inserted B   ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
	WHERE (  
		(COALESCE(TienChietKhau4,0)) + (COALESCE(TienChietKhau5,0)) + (COALESCE(TienChietKhau6,0)) + (COALESCE(TienChietKhau7,0)) 
		+ (COALESCE(TienChietKhau8,0))  + (COALESCE(TienChietKhau9,0)) <> 0
	) AND  COALESCE(ChietKhau4AccID,'') <> ''

	
    
 

END

CREATE TRIGGER AR_InvoiceTbl_UpdateStockTrans
ON AR_InvoiceTbl AFTER UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	 
	IF UPDATE(DocumentID) RETURN -- detail tự delete, insert lại nếu có update DocumentID

    -- Nếu user đổi DocumentDate
    IF UPDATE(DocumentDate) OR UPDATE(BranchID)
    BEGIN
        UPDATE st
        SET st.DocumentDate = i.DocumentDate, st.BranchID = i.BranchID
        FROM dbo.IV_StockTransactionTbl st
        INNER JOIN inserted i ON st.DocumentID = i.DocumentID
        WHERE st.TranType = 'SI' AND st.DocumentDate <> i.DocumentDate
    END;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[AR_Invoice_UpdateEntryTrans]
ON [dbo].[AR_InvoiceTbl] AFTER UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

	
	IF UPDATE(DocumentID) RETURN -- detail từ delete, insert lại nếu có update DocumentID
  
      IF UPDATE(RevAccID) OR UPDATE(VATAccID2)
	  BEGIN
		-- xóa insert lại
		UPDATE AR_InvoiceDetailTbl SET DocumentID = A.DocumentID
		FROM AR_InvoiceDetailTbl A
			 INNER JOIN inserted i ON A.DocumentID = i.DocumentID
		RETURN
	  END;

    -- Nếu user đổi DocumentDate
    IF UPDATE(DocumentDate) 
	OR UPDATE(ObjectID) 
	OR UPDATE(EmployeeID)  
	OR UPDATE(ManagerID)
	OR UPDATE(AgencyID)
    BEGIN
        UPDATE st
        SET st.DocumentDate = i.DocumentDate, 
		st.ObjectID = CASE when Coalesce(i.AgencyID,'') = '' then i.ObjectID else i.AgencyID end, 
		st.ObjectID2 = CASE when Coalesce(i.AgencyID,'') = '' then i.ObjectID else i.AgencyID end,
		st.EmployeeID = i.EmployeeID,
		st.ManagerID = i.ManagerID
        FROM dbo.GJ_TransactionTbl st
        INNER JOIN inserted i ON st.DocumentID = i.DocumentID
        WHERE st.SourceID = 'SI'  
    END;


END;

CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[AR_InvoiceTbl_UpdateRefDoc]
   ON  [dbo].[AR_InvoiceTbl] AFTER UPDATE
AS 
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

   -- Insert statements for trigger here

	IF ( UPDATE (DocumentID) )
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @DocumentID VARCHAR(50)
		DECLARE @DocumentID_Old VARCHAR(50)

		SELECT @DocumentID = DocumentID FROM inserted
		SELECT @DocumentID_Old = DocumentID FROM deleted
		EXEC SY_UpdateSystemRefDocStp @DocumentID, @DocumentID_Old, 'SI'

	END
	
	/*
	-- ko dung nua, viet vao AR_InvoiceLog_Stp khi user bam chuyen trang thai
	-- chuyen trang thai Don hang theo hoa don
	
	IF ( UPDATE (StatusID) )
	BEGIN
		UPDATE dbo.AR_OrderTbl SET StatusID = S.OrderStatusID
		FROM dbo.AR_OrderTbl A
			INNER JOIN inserted B ON A.DocumentID = B.PONo
			INNER JOIN dbo.AR_InvoiceStatusTbl S ON B.StatusID = S.StatusID
		WHERE A.StatusID < S.OrderStatusID
	END
	
	*/

END
